oracle.derivation: AABB z in [0.05,0.2] crosses near=0.1. A complete root cut is legal; a left-only cut while right is requested is a missing-page crack. Stale occlusion from a prior camera is invalid.
oracle.not_derived_from: Etalon culling occupancy as a completeness proof

tolerances.near_zero_policy: |r| <= atol + rtol*|expected|; nonfinite values are domain errors

provenance: Original analytic construction; no imported dataset; oracle values are closed-form or exact-integer and are not derived from QualiaDB/Etalon/Hypermedia implementation helpers
spec_exposure: Held-out geometry, views, and poses excluded from tuning
